cluster_1_evaluate_template_artifact.pack: Pack A (156 items), scattered in B/C/D (12 items)
cluster_1_evaluate_template_artifact.root_cause: Bulk-authoring template appended 'Which response is most appropriate?' to every stem, and the template engine interpreted this as Evaluate-level cognitive demand. Actual cognitive demand: single-standard comprehension (Understand).
cluster_1_evaluate_template_artifact.remediation: COGNITIVELEVEL_UPDATE: Evaluate→Understand, difficulty adjusted to match (Easy→ME/2).

cluster_2_pack_e_remember_inflation.root_cause: Pack E template engine assigned Remember to ALL definition-match items regardless of distractor sophistication. ~284 items have same-domain distractors requiring comprehension-level discrimination. Only ~102 items are genuine pure-recall (different-domain distractors or obvious wrong answers).
cluster_2_pack_e_remember_inflation.remediation: All 386 Remember→Understand (executor went beyond Agent D's 284 recommendation). Difficulty adjusted for the 76 items labeled Difficult (Block-C).

cluster_3_pack_e_difficult_inflation.root_cause: Template assigned Difficult/4 by position in rotation group regardless of cognitive demand. Items are definition-recall/definition-match with no calculation, no exhibits, and distractors from same domain.

key_warnings.understand_overcorrection: Understand CL jumped from 24.2% → 46.7% — far above the 15% CAQS target. This is a 31.7pp overcorrection. The Pack E executor shifted ALL 386 Remember items to Understand instead of the recommended 360 (leaving 26 Remember). The Pack A shift (156 Evaluate→Understand) was evidence-driven. Combined, these two dominate the pool's CL distribution.
key_warnings.analyze_shortfall: Analyze at 2.6% vs 25% CAQS target — a 22.4pp deficit. S719 did not increase Analyze (it was not in scope). Future content creation must focus on Analyze-level items.

key_warnings.understand_review_needed: With 46.7% Understand, many items previously labeled as Evaluate or Remember are now Understand.
